fix.why: On a Windows controller filepath.Dir('/data/dist/pkg.tgz') yields `\data\dist` (verified by running test on this host: filepath.Dir output includes backslash separators, path.Dir gives '/data/dist'). pkg/sftp MkdirAll splits on '/' only, so the whole backslash string was mkdir'd as one literal component under the SFTP CWD -> phantom `\data\dist` dir, real .dist never created -> Create failed SSH_FX_NO_SUCH_FILE -> engine masked as business.filedist.task.transferFailed. Backslash-laden inputs degrade to '.' (harmless MkdirAll('.')), client.Create still uses the user-supplied POSIX remotePath unchanged.

fix.imports: added "path" next to "path/filepath" (path/filepath still used by the local download line and by Upload wrapper)
